QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_42

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 9.9.1: Sharpe Ratio = (Rp − Rf) / σp. Measures excess return per unit of TOTAL risk (standard deviation). **The Trap:** Option A is Treynor (beta, not SD). Options C and D are malformed. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B, XV, X-A/B all test Sharpe; XIX-B for Cat III hedge. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Sharpe > 1 is preferable. Sharpe is unreliable for short track records or non-normal return distributions — supplement with Sortino (uses downside deviation only) for asymmetric-return funds.
